arms.nb-fan-f32 / nb-fan-f64: no-barrier on test_a_vertex_the_triangles_of_a_fan_share_is_claimed_by_exactly_one_of_them: NOT predicted to be caught (the laptop's fan test passed under the plant in both dtypes): rate 0/40 reported as measured, the test is a property, not a control of the barrier
arms.nb-camera-f32 / nb-camera-f64: no-barrier on test_an_axis_aligned_camera...: 40/40 each (the laptop failed it in both dtypes on its first plant run)
arms.np-closed-f32 / np-closed-f64: no-pad on test_a_ray_at_an_edge_of_a_closed_mesh...: 40/40 each (a box draw of 2048 rays holds about 4 to 10 odd crossings a draw)
arms.np-camera-f32 / np-camera-f64: no-pad on test_an_axis_aligned_camera...: 0/40 each, predicted (see seen_before)

gate_26_rates.basis: measured-before on the laptop; a runner's CPU may contract products differently (the barrier plant needs the backend to fuse a multiply-add: EPYC cores have FMA)
gate_26_rates.if_wrong: a no-barrier miss on a runner: the plant is invisible there, so the barrier's test is a laptop's evidence only, and the PR says so; a clean arm flagged: a false alarm, a test premise wrong

gate_cost.claim: through the real node, one process a variant, two rounds: the step's compile mesh over none 0.9 to 1.15; a run's second 30 steps (10 frames) mesh over none: float32 320x240 1.05 to 1.4, float64 320x240 1.2 to 2.2, float32 640x480 1.02 to 1.2, float64 640x480 1.05 to 1.5; the make once a run 3 to 10 s at 320x240 and 13 to 30 s at 640x480 (the first round's and the second's range)
gate_cost.basis: laptop microbenchmark of the signature (the new per-frame read of the tree's arrays) against the runner's frame cost of the first rounds (3.3 ms a frame float32, 5.4 ms float64 at 320x240)
gate_cost.if_wrong: over the band: the per-frame signature costs more than its microbenchmark (XLA's integer reductions on the runner's CPU); under: it fuses with the frame's other loops
